Casting [Air Move] with full Class Ability Energy consumes the charge and vertically thrusts you ? meters into the air. 

Ascension deals damage and <arc/>Jolts enemies within a 10 meter radius of the cast, while granting <arc/>Amplified to you and all allies within that same radius.

Casting Ascension triggers the effects of your equipped dodge. Scales up to 65% increased damage at 200 Class Stat.
